NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PLONK uses photos from your library only for the listing you are creating.
NSCameraUsageDescription: PLONK opens the camera so you can take photos of the item for your listing.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PLONK uses your location to pick your city and show listings near you. Coordinates are not sent anywhere.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PLONK uses the microphone to record voice messages in chats.
